lines.context: 双机实测 §fMist 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: These ethereal beings can create dense fog, obscuring vision and muffling sound.
lines.raw: §8§oThese ethereal beings can create §8§odense fog, obscuring vision and §8§omuffling sound.
lines.zh: 这些虚幻的生灵能制造浓雾，遮蔽视线、吞没声音。

lines.context: 双机实测 §fTank Zombie 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: These undead creatures are known for their resilience, shrugging off attacks that would fell lesser creatures.
lines.raw: §8§oThese undead creatures are known §8§ofor their resilience, shrugging off §8§oattacks that would fell lesser §8§ocreatures.
lines.zh: 这些亡灵生物以顽强著称，足以击倒弱小生物的攻击，对它们却无关痛痒。

lines.context: 双机实测 §fStrongarm 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: Strongarms live for the thrill of a midwinter snowball fight.
lines.raw: §8§oStrongarms live for the thrill of a §8§omidwinter snowball fight.
lines.zh: Strongarm 最喜欢的，就是在隆冬时节痛快地打上一场雪仗。

lines.context: 双机实测 §fShyworm 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: Shyworms are immensely afraid of all other living organisms, even fellow Shyworms, and tend to prefer dark places because most other critters don't.
lines.raw: §8§oShyworms are immensely afraid of all §8§oother living organisms, even fellow §8§oShyworms, and tend to prefer dark §8§oplaces because most other critters §8§odon't.
lines.zh: Shyworm 极度惧怕其他生物，连同类也不例外。它们偏爱阴暗的角落，因为大多数小动物都不喜欢那里。

lines.context: 双机实测 §fFoxtrot 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: The Foxtrot moves with unparalleled elegance, almost gliding across the forest floor.
lines.raw: §8§oThe Foxtrot moves with unparalleled §8§oelegance, almost gliding across the §8§oforest floor.
lines.zh: Foxtrot 的动作优雅无比，行走时仿佛在林地上滑翔。

lines.context: 双机实测 §aZombie Soldier 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: Zombie Soldiers march tirelessly through the catacombs, their decayed bodies clad in ancient, rusting armor.
lines.raw: §8§oZombie Soldiers march tirelessly §8§othrough the catacombs, their §8§odecayed bodies clad in ancient, §8§orusting armor.
lines.zh: 僵尸士兵身披古老锈蚀的盔甲，拖着腐朽的身躯，在地下墓穴中不知疲倦地行军。

lines.context: 双机实测 §aZealot Bruiser 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: These elite Zealots are fiercely loyal to the Ender Dragons, guarding their domains with unmatched strength.
lines.raw: §8§oThese elite Zealots are fiercely §8§oloyal to the Ender Dragons, guarding §8§otheir domains with unmatched §8§ostrength.
lines.zh: 这些精锐的狂热末影人对末影龙忠心耿耿，以无可匹敌的力量守护它们的领地。

lines.context: 双机实测 §aPolaris 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: Polaris are very territorial, opting to attack first and ask questions later.
lines.raw: §8§oPolaris are very territorial, opting §8§oto attack first and ask questions §8§olater.
lines.zh: Polaris 的领地意识极强，向来先动手，再问来者何人。

lines.context: 双机实测 §aDuplico 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: The Duplico mimics its surroundings to stay out of sight of its targets. Staying near a Duplico for a prolonged period can evoke feelings of dread and paranoia.
lines.raw: §8§oThe Duplico mimics its surroundings §8§oto stay out of sight of its targets. §8§oStaying near a Duplico for a §8§oprolonged period can evoke feelings §8§oof dread and paranoia.
lines.zh: Duplico 会模仿周围的环境，躲开目标的视线。在它身边待得太久，会让人感到恐惧，变得疑神疑鬼。

lines.context: 双机实测 §aGazer 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: Nothing is known about the Gazer, save for the fact that it detests light.
lines.raw: §8§oNothing is known about the Gazer, §8§osave for the fact that it detests §8§olight.
lines.zh: 人们对 Gazer 一无所知，只知道它厌恶光亮。

lines.context: 双机实测 §aSolsnatcher 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: Solsnatchers tend to loiter idly throughout the day but grow in confidence during the night.
lines.raw: §8§oSolsnatchers tend to loiter idly §8§othroughout the day but grow in §8§oconfidence during the night.
lines.zh: Solsnatcher 白天总是无所事事地游荡，到了夜晚却会大胆起来。

lines.context: 双机实测 §aDriftling 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: It drifts around aimlessly, going wherever the wind takes it.
lines.raw: §8§oIt drifts around aimlessly, going §8§owherever the wind takes it.
lines.zh: 它漫无目的地漂浮着，风吹向哪里，它就去哪里。

lines.context: 双机实测 §fFlitter 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: Born blind, Flitters often spend their entire lives flying in the same direction. Because of this, they can end up just about anywhere.
lines.raw: §8§oBorn blind, Flitters often spend their §8§oentire lives flying in the same §8§odirection. Because of this, they can §8§oend up just about anywhere.
lines.zh: Flitter 生来双目失明，常常一辈子都朝同一个方向飞。因此，哪里都有可能见到它们。

lines.context: 双机实测 §fTepid 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: Tepids can only survive in waters of a very specific temperature, hence them being exclusive to the Critter Safari's lake.
lines.raw: §8§oTepids can only survive in waters of §8§oa very specific temperature, hence §8§othem being exclusive to the Critter §8§oSafari's lake.
lines.zh: Tepid 只能在温度极为特定的水中生存，因此只出没于小动物游猎的湖泊中。

lines.context: 双机实测 §fCavernfish 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: Cavernfish stick to the quiet caves due to the solace they offer from predators and other unwanted visitors.
lines.raw: §8§oCavernfish stick to the quiet caves §8§odue to the solace they offer from §8§opredators and other unwanted §8§ovisitors.
lines.zh: Cavernfish 栖居在安静的洞穴，躲避捕食者和其他不速之客。

lines.context: 双机实测 §fFirefox 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: Their eyes glow with an intense heat, allowing them to see clearly even on the darkest of nights.
lines.raw: §8§oTheir eyes glow with an intense heat, §8§oallowing them to see clearly even on §8§othe darkest of nights.
lines.zh: 它们的双眼闪烁着炽热的光芒，即使在最漆黑的夜晚也能看清四周。

lines.context: 双机实测 §fGroundhog 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: A Groundhog's teeth never stop growing throughout their entire lives.
lines.raw: §8§oA Groundhog's teeth never stop §8§ogrowing throughout their entire lives.
lines.zh: 土拨鼠的牙齿终其一生都在不断生长。

lines.context: 双机实测 §fHoneybuzz 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: They will defend their colony - and its honey - resolutely.

lines.zh: 它们会坚决捍卫自己的族群，以及族群的蜂蜜。

lines.context: 双机实测 §fPollendart 的完整 Lore 说明。

lines.context: 双机实测 §aBambuleaf 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: This gentle giant is often seen lounging lazily among the bamboo, munching on leaves with a contented expression.
lines.raw: §8§oThis gentle giant is often seen §8§olounging lazily among the bamboo, §8§omunching on leaves with a contented §8§oexpression.
lines.zh: 这个温顺的大家伙常常懒洋洋地躺在竹林间，一脸满足地嚼着竹叶。

lines.raw: §8§oTreefrogs have specialized toe pads §8§oto aid with climbing and jumping. Some §8§ocan even camouflage!

lines.context: 双机实测 §aHoneybug 的完整 Lore 说明。

lines.context: 双机实测 §aShuddersquid 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: Shuddersquids live only in the deepest waters of the coldest regions. They use the light that emanates from their bodies to guide the way and spot other Shuddersquids from afar, though this trait also makes them an easy target for predators.
lines.raw: §8§oShuddersquids live only in the §8§odeepest waters of the coldest §8§oregions. They use the light that §8§oemanates from their bodies to guide §8§othe way and spot other §8§oShuddersquids from afar, though §8§othis trait also makes them an easy §8§otarget for predators.
lines.zh: Shuddersquid 只生活在最寒冷地区的最深水域。它们靠身体发出的光照亮前路，也借此辨认远处的同类；但这道光也让它们容易成为捕食者的目标。

lines.context: 双机实测 Vulture 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: Their bald heads and powerful beaks are perfectly adapted for their scavenging lifestyle, allowing them to feed efficiently on carcasses.
lines.raw: §8§oTheir bald heads and powerful beaks §8§oare perfectly adapted for their §8§oscavenging lifestyle, allowing them to §8§ofeed efficiently on carcasses.
